Summary: US-01 Ask 'Where is my order?' in my own words
Description:
As a customer, I want to ask 'Where is my order?' in my own words, so that I get the status without waiting for an agent.

Acceptance criteria:
* Given I am verified (PG-01), when I ask about my order, then the assistant shows the status and expected delivery date from the order system within 5 seconds.
* If I have more than one active order, the assistant lists them (masked) and asks which one.

MoSCoW: Must

Summary: US-02 Start a return in chat
Description:
As a customer, I want to start a return in chat, so that I do not have to fill a separate form.

Acceptance criteria:
* Given the item is within the return window, when I ask to return it, then the assistant explains the policy with a link (AG-04), creates the return and shows the pickup date.
* Given the item is outside the window or non-returnable, then the assistant explains why and offers a human (HT-07 does not apply).

MoSCoW: Must

As a customer, I want to check my refund status, so that I know when the money will reach me.

Acceptance criteria:
* The assistant shows refund amount, method and expected credit date from the returns system.
* It never estimates a date the system did not return (AG-03).

MoSCoW: Must

Summary: US-04 Reach a human at any time
Description:
As a customer, I want to reach a human at any time, so that I am never stuck with a bot.

Acceptance criteria:
* Given I type a request for a human, then I am handed off immediately (HT-01) and told the expected wait time.

MoSCoW: Must

Summary: US-05 Answers to policy questions to link to the official policy
Description:
As a customer, I want answers to policy questions to link to the official policy, so that I can trust them.

Acceptance criteria:
* Every policy answer includes a link to the source knowledge base article (AG-04).
* If the answer is not in the knowledge base, the assistant says it does not know and offers a human (AG-01).

MoSCoW: Must

Summary: US-06 Know I am talking to an AI and how my data is used
Description:
As a customer, I want to know I am talking to an AI and how my data is used, so that I can decide whether to continue.

Acceptance criteria:
* The first message states the assistant is an AI, that I can ask for a human, and links the privacy notice (PG-06).

MoSCoW: Must

Summary: US-07 Rate the chat at the end
Description:
As a customer, I want to rate the chat at the end, so that the company knows if it helped.

Acceptance criteria:
* When the chat closes (AI or agent), a 1-5 CSAT question is shown.
* The rating is stored with the chat ID and whether it was handed off.

MoSCoW: Should

Summary: US-08 The full transcript and an AI summary when a chat is handed to me
Description:
As a Support Agent, I want the full transcript and an AI summary when a chat is handed to me, so that the customer does not repeat themselves.

Acceptance criteria:
* The summary shows intent, order ID, steps already taken and the handoff reason in 5 lines or fewer.
* The customer is not asked again for information already in the transcript.

MoSCoW: Must

Summary: US-09 See why a chat was handed off
Description:
As a Support Agent, I want to see why a chat was handed off, so that I can respond in the right way.

Acceptance criteria:
* The handoff reason (HT-01 to HT-07) is shown as a label.
* Priority handoffs (HT-05) appear at the top of my queue.

MoSCoW: Should

Summary: US-10 Tag the reason a chat needed a human after I resolve it
Description:
As a Support Agent, I want to tag the reason a chat needed a human after I resolve it, so that the team can improve the assistant.

Acceptance criteria:
* Before closing a handed-off chat, I must pick a reason tag (e.g., missing policy, wrong answer, customer preference).

MoSCoW: Should

Summary: US-11 Flag an incorrect AI answer from the transcript
Description:
As a Support Agent, I want to flag an incorrect AI answer from the transcript, so that it can be fixed in the knowledge base.

Acceptance criteria:
* Each AI message has a 'Flag answer' action with a required comment.
* Flagged answers appear in the Team Lead's review list.

MoSCoW: Could

Summary: US-12 Approve knowledge base articles before the assistant uses them
Description:
As a Support Team Lead, I want to approve knowledge base articles before the assistant uses them, so that answers follow current policy.

Acceptance criteria:
* Only articles with status Approved are available to the assistant (AG-01).
* Editing an approved article returns it to Draft until re-approved.

MoSCoW: Must

Summary: US-13 A weekly sample of 50 AI conversations to review
Description:
As a Support Team Lead, I want a weekly sample of 50 AI conversations to review, so that I can measure answer accuracy.

Acceptance criteria:
* Every Monday, 50 random AI-only conversations from the past week are listed with Correct / Incorrect / Partially correct options (AG-06).
* Accuracy % is calculated automatically.

MoSCoW: Should

Summary: US-14 A dashboard of deflection rate, first response time and CSAT
Description:
As a Support Team Lead, I want a dashboard of deflection rate, first response time and CSAT, so that I can judge whether the pilot is working.

Acceptance criteria:
* The dashboard shows the KPIs in kpi/KPI_Definitions.xlsx, daily and for the pilot to date.
* AI chats and agent chats can be compared side by side.

MoSCoW: Must

Summary: US-15 Change handoff thresholds without a code release
Description:
As a Support Team Lead, I want to change handoff thresholds without a code release, so that I can tune the pilot.

Acceptance criteria:
* Confidence threshold, sentiment threshold and refund limit are editable by the Team Lead role.
* Every change is logged with user and timestamp.

MoSCoW: Could

Summary: US-16 Customers verified by OTP before order details are shown
Description:
As a Compliance Officer, I want customers verified by OTP before order details are shown, so that personal data is not exposed.

Acceptance criteria:
* No order data is shown before OTP success (PG-01).
* 3 failed attempts lock order lookups for the chat and trigger HT-06.

MoSCoW: Must

Summary: US-17 Payment details masked and personal data redacted before it reaches the LLM
Description:
As a Compliance Officer, I want payment details masked and personal data redacted before it reaches the LLM, so that we meet data protection obligations.

Acceptance criteria:
* Card numbers, CVV and UPI PIN patterns are masked in the transcript and a warning is shown (PG-03).
* Text sent to the LLM provider contains no unmasked phone, email, address or payment data (PG-04).

MoSCoW: Must

As a Compliance Officer, I want transcripts deleted after 90 days, so that we do not keep personal data longer than needed.

Acceptance criteria:
* A daily job deletes transcripts older than 90 days and logs the count deleted (PG-05).
* Only Support and Compliance roles can open transcripts.

MoSCoW: Must
